name: fennec
prompt: Edit/derive a game sprite animation atlas from the attached existing Itoeva character identity reference. Preserve exactly this character's colors, costume, silhouette, face and detailed pixel-art finish. Slim orange fennec fox, huge ears, brown hooded cape, cream muzzle, boots. His arms sweep outward then back with bent elbows, folded knees push back and then recover, cape trails gently behind in water. True swimming with visible anatomically bent limbs, no Superman flying, no standing walk pose, no bobbing-only, no body inflation. Transparent background, absolutely no water, foam, shadows, labels or decoration. Exactly TWELVE fully isolated full-body sprites in a perfectly regular FOUR-COLUMN THREE-ROW grid with generous equal clear gutters. Row 1: swimming right in strict side view. Row 2: swimming towards camera front view. Row 3: swimming away from camera rear view. Each row is FOUR sequential continuous stroke phases: reach/recover with bent limbs, open catch/sweep, pull/push backward, compact glide. The torso/head pose and scale are exactly constant across each row; only actual limbs and trailing cape/tail articulate. Head held above imagined waterline, body reclining slightly (~15 degrees), visible lower limbs and tail included, not underwater hidden. No dramatic torso rotation. All sprites equally scaled, equal head positions per row, fit completely in their own equal grid cell. Fine crisp game pixel art, hard transparent edges, not a concept painting, not a 3D render.
